title: EDF offers UK customers free seven-year service, warranty on air-source heat pumps
content:
The company says the offer, available until the end of August, is to encourage UK homeowners to install a heat pump before demand for low-carbon heating grows ahead of winter.

title: During heatwave, solar power supports France’s grid as nuclear output slows
content:
Heatwaves and drought have forced several French nuclear reactors offline, while strong solar generation has helped stabilize the grid.
As solar output falls after sunset, battery storage could help meet high evening demand and reduce reliance on gas-fired generation.

title: El Salvador launches regulatory framework for solar self-consumption
content:
El Salvador has begun implementing its new renewable self-consumption framework, opening procedures for providers and solar PV installations. The regime introduces tax incentives, grid compensation for surplus generation, and provisions for energy storage and distributed self-consumption.

title: Saatvik Solar to add 3.6 GW of cell manufacturing capacity in India
content:
Saatvik Solar Industries is planning to add 3.6 GW of solar cell manufacturing capacity at Gopalpur, Odisha, as its existing 2.4 GW cell and 4 GW module manufacturing facility at the site nears commissioning.

title: Megarevo differentiates with customer-focused microgrid solutions as it scales European operations
content: Brian Yaw, founder of Megarevo, discussed the company’s approach to commercial and industrial energy storage, their competitive strategy, and plans for the European market with Energy-Storage.news at Intersolar Europe 2026.

title: Relectrify installs first AC1 inverterless battery storage system in South Australia
content: Melbourne-based battery technology company Relectrify has installed its first AC1 battery energy storage system (BESS) in Renmark, South Australia, in partnership with YES Energy.

title: Australian Renewable Energy Agency backs UNSW research into grid-forming battery storage and system strength
content: UNSW receives AU$6.52 million to study how solar, wind and battery storage interact with grid protection systems as Australia transitions to renewables.

title: Australia’s Cheaper Home Batteries Program officially passes 500,000 installations
content: More than 507,000 households, small businesses and community organisations have installed a home battery storage system under Australia's Cheaper Home Batteries Program, according to figures announced by Prime Minister Anthony Albanese and Energy Minister Chris Bowen.
